rule: A mutant counts as caught only when its suite reaches the baseline check count and at least one check fails; a bash mutant also passes bash -n. Each mutant runs in its own copy of the files the suites read; targetFailed says whether the check the mutant was written for, found by its label, is among the failures.
baselineNote: Baselines are the GREEN runs at a40103c, whose code the measured commit keeps; the PowerShell and bash suites ran side by side.
loadNote: Three PowerShell mutants ran at a time, then two bash mutants at a time, on one machine; seconds are wall times under that load.
